name: Eoalulavis
sum: Goldfinch-sized Barremian enantiornithean from Las Hoyas, Spain, the oldest bird known with an alula.
holotype: A partial skeleton prepared by acid and transferred to a resin cast (number in Sanz et al. 1996).
biology: Its alula (bastard wing) suggests fine control in slow flight.
author: Sanz et al. 1996
